# Luma (لوما)

> Luma (لوما) is a Persian-language artificial intelligence platform providing tools for image generation and editing, video creation and enhancement, speech synthesis, intelligent chat, virtual try-on, and visual workflow automation.

## What Luma Is

Luma is a web-based artificial intelligence platform designed for Persian-speaking creators, teams, and developers. It brings together generative and processing models in a unified interface for digital content creation and automation.

- Route: /
- Route: /about

## Main Capabilities

The platform provides creative artificial intelligence capabilities across multiple media modalities:

- Image Generation (ساخت تصویر): Creating images from text prompts.
- Image Editing (ویرایش تصویر): Editing images with text instructions, including modifying parts and removing or replacing objects.
- Background Removal (حذف پس‌زمینه): Removing image backgrounds with subject isolation.
- Image Upscaling (افزایش کیفیت تصویر): Improving clarity and recovering details of older images.
- Video Generation (ساخت ویدیو): Generating videos from text prompts and reference images.
- Video Enhancement (افزایش کیفیت ویدئو): Enhancing video clarity, reconstructing details, and improving frame rate.
- Text-to-Speech (تبدیل متن به گفتار): Converting Persian and multilingual text to natural and professional speech.
- Virtual Try-On (پوشاندن لباس): Virtual garment fitting on selected models.
- Smart Chat (چت هوشمند): Conversational interaction with advanced language models.
- Smart Assistant (دستیار هوشمند): Conversational assistant for everyday tasks based on platform documentation.
- Workflows (ورک‌فلوها): Visual canvas for designing and executing multi-step artificial intelligence processes.

## Services

Luma includes eleven core services verified in the platform:

- ساخت تصویر (Image Generation) — تبدیل متن به تصاویر هنری خیره‌کننده. Route: /service/img-gen
- ویرایش تصویر (Image Editing) — ویرایش حرفه‌ای تصاویر با دستورات متنی. Route: /service/img-edit
- حذف پس‌زمینه (Background Removal) — حذف هوشمند و دقیق پس‌زمینه تصاویر. Route: /service/bg-remove
- دستیار هوشمند (Smart Assistant) — دستیار همه فن حریف برای کارهای روزمره. Route: /service/assistant
- ساخت ویدیو (Video Generation) — خلق ویدیوهای خلاقانه از متن. Route: /service/video
- افزایش کیفیت ویدئو (Video Enhancement) — افزایش وضوح، بازسازی جزئیات و بهبود ویدئو با مدلهای تخصصی. Route: /service/video-enhancement
- تبدیل متن به گفتار (Text-to-Speech) — تبدیل متن فارسی و چندزبانه به صدای طبیعی و حرفه‌ای. Route: /service/text-to-speech
- افزایش کیفیت تصویر (Image Upscaling) — بهبود وضوح و جزئیات تصاویر قدیمی. Route: /service/upscale
- پوشاندن لباس (Virtual Try-On) — پرو مجازی لباس بر روی مدل‌های دلخواه. Route: /service/try-on
- چت هوشمند (Smart Chat) — گفتگو با پیشرفته‌ترین مدل‌های زبانی. Route: /service/chat
- ورک‌فلوها (Workflows) — بوم بصری ساخت فرآیندهای چندمرحله‌ای هوش مصنوعی. Route: /service/workflow

Services Catalog Page:
- Complete directory of platform services. Route: /services

## Pricing and Subscription

Luma operates on a credit-based payment model:

- Current Payment Model: Users currently access services by charging and consuming LUM credits, without requiring a monthly subscription.
- Cost Transparency: The dashboard displays the cost before an operation is executed, which serves as the basis for credit deduction.
- Planned Subscriptions: Subscription plans described on the platform represent proposed or planned structures for future studio capacity, rather than an active payment requirement.
- Route: /pricing
- Route: /subscription

## Documentation and Tutorials

Luma provides educational and technical documentation:

- Technical Documentation: API references, guides, and model parameter descriptions. Route: /docs
- Tutorials: Practical guides demonstrating prompt crafting and workflow construction. Route: /tutorials
- Gallery: Visual showcase of images and videos generated with Luma AI tools, including prompt examples. Route: /gallery

The Luma blog serves as an educational and news resource:

- Dynamic Content: Articles and publications are loaded dynamically through the platform.
- Route: /blog
